kinds.d: The hind leg of a deer, whole or as a roasting joint or steaks, on or off the bone.

notes: All six planned kinds kept; saddle and medallions merged (Venison saddle & loin), mince and burgers merged. Species and schemes are archetypes of Venison by species (red, roe, fallow, sika, muntjac, axis, reindeer, elk/moose, Cervena, Scottish Quality Wild Venison); cut is detail. Cervena year left out (sources differ 1991-93). No brand entries: no maker is an archetype mk. Chinese water deer left out (no fetched page).
